::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this page does

The annual-report workflow creates two linked products from exact approved CVD event and mortality data releases:

- the full annual CVD report; and
- a one-page public health update containing the same headline analytical content as the report’s final page.

Step 1 builds five private proposed files. Step 2 records human approval of those exact files. Step 3 publishes only the approved files.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
1. Prepare and review the three year-specific content files.
2. Run Step 1 and review all five private proposed files.
3. Run Step 2 to approve the unchanged five-file package.
4. Run Step 3 to publish the approved package.
5. Render and review both landing pages, both PDFs and both report listings.
:::

## Before you start

- Complete Step 6 for the selected CVD event and mortality data releases.
- Choose the surveillance year shown on the report cover. The later publication date is stored separately in the landing-page fields.
- Start with report version 1. Use a higher version for a correction after approval or publication.
- Prepare the interpretation, Special chapter and Special-chapter contents files for the report year.
- Do not edit the three invariant workflow controllers during routine report production.

In the file patterns below, `YYYY` is the report year and `N` is the report version.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Input files"}

| File | What Step 1 uses or checks |
|---|---|
| `$BNR_PUBLIC/metrics/cvd/cvd_metrics_cvd_YYYY_MM.csv` | Official approved CVD event data-release file. |
| `$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/datasets/cvd_metrics_cvd_YYYY_MM.csv` | Website copy; it must match the official event file by size and checksum—a value used to detect a changed file. |
| `$BNR_PUBLIC/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Official approved mortality data-release file. |
| `$BNR_REPO/site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Website copy; it must match the official mortality file by size and checksum. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/annual/YYYY/bnr_report_annual_YYYY_interpretation.do` | Reviewed year-specific narrative and the three concise messages used in the public health update. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/annual/YYYY/bnr_report_annual_YYYY_focus.do` | Composes the year-specific Special chapter. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/annual/YYYY/bnr_report_annual_YYYY_toc.csv` | Reader-facing contents entries for the Special chapter. |

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Code files"}

| File | How it is used |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s1_build.do` | Step 1 controller; run by the menu, dialog or Stata command. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_standard.do` | Reusable Stata composition for the standard report chapters. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/templates/bnr_report_annual_public_health_update.do` | Composes the report’s final one-page public health update. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/templates/bnr_report_annual_toc.csv` | Maintained contents entries for standard report chapters. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/templates/bnr_report_annual_appendix_toc.csv` | Maintained contents entries for report appendices. |
| `scripts/python/stamp_annual_report_pdf.py` | Adds presentation-only PDF page furniture and linked contents, then extracts and finishes the one-page update. It does not read data or change analytical content. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s2_approve.do` | Step 2 approval controller. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_approve_candidate.do` | Shared helper that verifies and copies the five approved files and creates approval evidence. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s3_publish.do` | Step 3 publication controller. |
| `scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_publish_candidate.do` | Shared helper that verifies and publishes the approved files. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/bnr_report_annual_s1_build.dlg` | Step 1 Stata dialog. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/bnr_report_annual_s2_approve.dlg` | Step 2 Stata dialog. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/bnr_report_annual_s3_publish.dlg` | Step 3 Stata dialog. |
| `scripts/stata/menu/bnr_menu.do` | Adds all three annual-report steps to the BNR Stata menu. |

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Output files"}

Step 1 creates five private proposed files under `$BNR_STAGING/reports/cvd/annual/bnr_cvd_annual_report_YYYY_vN/candidate/`.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `bnr_cvd_annual_report_YYYY_vN.pdf` | Complete proposed annual report. **Open this first.** |
| `bnr_cvd_public_health_update_YYYY_vN.pdf` | Proposed one-page public health update extracted from the report. |
| `index.qmd` | Proposed annual-report landing page. |
| `public_health_update.qmd` | Proposed one-page-update landing page. |
| `report.yml` | Generated report identity, version, source data releases, filenames and build information. |

Step 2 copies those five unchanged files into `public_ready/` and adds:

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `public_manifest.csv` | Private generated list of the exact five files Step 3 may publish, with file sizes and checksums. |
| `approval.yml` | Private approval record, written last. Approval does not mean publication. |

`public_ready` is the private folder holding the files authorised for Step 3. It is not a public location.

Step 3 publishes the stable public files below. The public filenames omit the version; `report.yml` retains it.

| File | Published location |
|---|---|
| `bnr_cvd_annual_report_YYYY.pdf` | `$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/annual/YYYY/` and `site/downloads/files/reports/cvd/annual/YYYY/`. |
| `bnr_cvd_public_health_update_YYYY.pdf` | The same official public and website-download folders. |
| `index.qmd` | `$BNR_PUBLIC/reports/cvd/annual/YYYY/` and `site/surveillance/cvd/reports/annual/YYYY/`. |
| `public_health_update.qmd` | Official public annual folder and `site/surveillance/cvd/reports/briefings/YYYY/index.qmd`. |
| `report.yml` | Official public annual folder and website-download folder. |

Private logs are written under `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/` with `bnr_report_annual_s1_`, `bnr_report_annual_s2_` and `bnr_report_annual_s3_` prefixes followed by the report ID.

:::

## Step 1: build and review the proposed report

1. Review the year-specific interpretation, Special chapter and contents files. Confirm every statement and source relates to the selected surveillance year.
2. In Stata, choose **User > BNR > Annual CVD report > Step 1: Build annual report candidate**.
3. Enter the report year, CVD event data-release year and month, mortality data-release year and month, and report version. Leave replacement unticked for a first build and select **Build candidate**.
4. Alternatively, enter the complete routine command in the **Stata command window**:

   ```stata
   do "scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s1_build.do" 2025 2026 1 2026 7 1
   ```

5. To rebuild the same unapproved version deliberately, enter the complete replacement command:

   ```stata
   do "scripts/stata/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s1_build.do" 2025 2026 1 2026 7 1 replace
   ```

6. In `ANNUAL CVD REPORT STEP 1: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY`, confirm `Run status: Candidate created` and check the report ID, source data releases and candidate folder.
7. Open the full PDF first. Check every page, linked contents, Special chapter, methods content and final public-health-update page.
8. Open the separate update PDF. Confirm it is exactly one page and contains the same analytical content as the report’s final page.
9. Review every table, chart, explanatory statement and public download together to confirm that no protected value is shown or can be calculated.
10. Preview both QMD files. Confirm titles, descriptions, dates, images, categories and public PDF links.
11. Open `report.yml` and confirm the report year, version, source data-release IDs and five filenames.

If this version has already been approved, Step 1 will not replace it. Create and review a higher version instead.

## Step 2: approve the five reviewed files

The implemented annual package contains five files. Review and approve all five, even if the current dialog introductory text refers to three files.

1. In Stata, choose **User > BNR > Annual CVD report > Step 2: Approve annual report candidate**.
2. Enter the report year, version, approver’s full name and authorised role.
3. Confirm that the complete proposed package was reviewed, disclosure review was completed and the exact files are ready for publication.
4. Select **Approve candidate**.
5. Alternatively, enter the complete command in the **Stata command window**:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s2_approve.do" ///
       2025 1 "Full Name" "BNR Analyst" ///
       candidate disclosure ready
   ```

6. In `ANNUAL CVD REPORT STEP 2: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY`, confirm `Run status: Candidate approved` and `Approval scope: Annual report + one-page update`.
7. Confirm `public_manifest.csv` lists exactly five files and `approval.yml` identifies the correct approver, role, report and version.

Only an authorised **BNR Lead** or **BNR Analyst** may approve. Step 2 has no `replace` option; an approved package is fixed.

## Step 3: publish the approved report

1. In Stata, choose **User > BNR > Annual CVD report > Step 3: Publish approved annual report**.
2. Enter the approved report year and version. Leave replacement unticked for first publication and select **Publish annual report**.
3. Alternatively, enter the complete routine command in the **Stata command window**:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s3_publish.do" 2025 1
   ```

4. For controlled republication of an existing approved version, enter the complete replacement command:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/reporting/bnr_report_annual_s3_publish.do" 2025 1 replace
   ```

5. In `ANNUAL CVD REPORT STEP 3: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY`, confirm `Run status: Published successfully` and check both PDF and landing-page locations.
6. Confirm the official public files and website copies match the five approved files.
7. Complete a full local Quarto render. Open both landing pages and PDFs, then check both automatic report listings.
8. Review all Git changes before following the normal development-branch deployment route.

Use a higher approved version for a correction. Same-version `replace` is reserved for controlled recovery and the publisher refuses a downgrade.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="If an annual-report step does not complete"}

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| An official source CSV and its website copy differ | Rerun the relevant analytical Step 6. Do not edit either source file. |
| PDF finishing or one-page extraction stops | Confirm the repository Python environment, helper, logo and three contents-specification files are present. Rerun Step 1 after correcting the missing dependency. |
| A reviewed file changed before approval | Rebuild and review the complete Step 1 package; do not approve a different file. |
| Existing public output blocks Step 3 | Confirm the intended approved version. Use a higher version for a correction or `replace` only for controlled same-version recovery. |

For other problems, see [Troubleshoot the workflow](../../maintenance/troubleshooting.qmd).

:::
